camps.name: Camp Acorn at Somerset Hills YMCA
camps.description_short: YMCA day camp at the Somerset Hills Y in Basking Ridge, 9 to 4, with swim lessons twice a week in the Y's indoor pools, sports, arts, science and a weekly bus trip. Groups run from preschool (ages 3 to 5, 9 to 2) and KinderCamp through grades 1 to 6, plus teen travel camp for grades 7 to 9 and a CIT program for grades 10 to 11.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Full refund for cancellations before May 1, 2026; after that the Y keeps $50 per week per child, except for documented medical reasons. Fees are charged 14 days before each session.

camps.name: Camp Clifton
camps.description_short: Full day Boys & Girls Club camp for members ages 6 to 14 (from 1st grade) at the Clifton clubhouse, 8:30 to 5:30 in one week sessions. Campers are grouped by age with a group leader, swim in the club pool, and can sign up for paid trips to water parks, amusement parks and bowling.
camps.refund_policy_summary: A nonrefundable deposit equal to one month's tuition is applied to the final month. Withdrawals must be filed 30 days before the final month; refunds come as portal credit, or less $10 by other means.
camps.notes: $160 a week for the first child and $150 for each additional child, plus a nonrefundable club membership of $40 ($30 per additional child). Clifton residents who meet income rules can apply for a limited number of scholarships or a $110 reduced weekly rate. Trips cost extra ($10 to $50) and need a $10 trip shirt. Lunch and snack are provided free Monday to Friday. Up to 240 campers a week, groups at 15 to 1. All applicants go on a waitlist until space is confirmed. The club also runs Kinderkare Camp for kindergartners ($800 a month) and Camp Gingerbread for ages 2.5 to 4 ($850 a month) on the same dates.

Three-Quarter Day (3 year olds, until 2:00) $2,930 to $8,100. Day Trippers (grades 7 to 9) $5,100 to $9,600. Minimum two consecutive weeks. Tuition includes either bus service or extended day (8:00 to 9:00 and 4:00 to 6:00); both cost extra. Camp is closed Monday July 5.

camps.name: Camp Vacamas Sleepaway Camp
camps.description_short: Nonprofit overnight camp on a lake in West Milford with 12 and 19 day sessions for ages 6 to 17. Campers swim, canoe, climb, do a ropes course and zip line, and play sports, and fees follow a sliding scale based on family income.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Waterfront activities are run by American Red Cross certified swim instructors and lifeguards with a waterfront director.
camps.notes: Session prices are the top tier for household income over $150,000. Lower tiers by income: under $70,000 pays $685 for Session 1 and $1,055 for Sessions 2 or 3; $70,001 to $100,000 pays $925 and $1,470; $100,001 to $150,000 pays $1,195 and $1,885. Every session adds a nonrefundable $90 registration fee ($60 for additional trips). Free buses from New York City, Westchester and selected New Jersey locations. Sibling discounts available. No parent visits during sessions. The same organization runs a day camp and a teen camp, listed separately if at all.

Lunch and bus service are not described. A separate preschool camp on the same campus serves ages 2.5 to entering K.

Tuition includes door to door minibus transport in most areas, hot lunch and two snacks. $500 deposit, refundable until 12/1/2026. Sibling discounts of $300 to $1,000. Camp is closed Monday July 5.

camps.name: Summer at Far Brook
camps.description_short: Summer day camp on the Far Brook School campus in Short Hills, open to all families. Day campers rotate through art, science, music, theater, archery and outdoor play around a weekly theme, with water play on Fridays; the school also runs week long STEAM and specialty classes, sport clinics and leadership programs for older campers.
camps.refund_policy_summary: $50 registration fee is not refundable. Cancellations by May 31, 2026 are refunded less that fee; from June 1 families get a credit for unused weeks, good through summer 2027.
camps.notes: 2026 rates: Day Camp full day $695 a week ($585 in the short weeks of June 19 and July 4); half day for Nursery 3s $495; STEAM and specialty $715; single sport clinics $500 to $650; Mentors $695; Young Leaders $585 to $695. Swim lessons add $125 a week for Nursery 4s and up. Two week minimum, weeks need not be consecutive. Camp hours 9:00 to 3:30; extended hours 8:00 to 9:00 ($20 an hour) and 3:30 to 5:30 ($30 an hour). Snack included; lunch can be bought from an outside caterer.

camps.operator_name: The Growing Stage, The Children's Theatre of New Jersey
camps.description_short: Week long theater camp at the historic Palace Theatre in Netcong, run by The Growing Stage children's theatre. Campers from kindergarten through 8th grade take daily drama, dance, music and art classes in small groups and put on a themed show each Friday.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Full refund if cancelled before June 1; no refunds after June 1. Processing fees are not refundable.
camps.notes: Camp day runs 8:45 am to 2:00 pm. $350 a week, $325 for additional weeks and siblings. Groups are set by the grade a child completes in June. All 2026 weeks were full; 2026 registration opened January 28.

camps.name: Peck Summer Program
camps.description_short: Two June weeks of half day enrichment classes on The Peck School campus in Morristown, open to children from the wider community. Children entering grades 1 to 8 pick morning and afternoon classes such as sports, ocean science, engineering, LEGO, art, claymation, music and musical theater for a 9:00 to 3:00 day; a morning program serves ages 3 to 5.
camps.notes: Class fees are not posted on the page; the school says details, class listings and fees usually appear in early January. Morning classes 9:00 to 11:30 and afternoon classes 12:30 to 3:00. Free BeforeCare 8:30 to 9:00; AfterSchool 3:00 to 5:00 for a fee. K Express (June 15 to 18) is only for incoming Peck kindergartners.

camps.name: Verona Recreation Summer Playgrounds
camps.description_short: Five week township playground camps for children turning 4 through grade 8, run at four Verona schools by age group: REC-LOT for pre-K and kindergarten, REC-PARK, Elementary Zone, and Junior and Summer Adventure, with crafts, games, sports and optional pool and field trips for older groups.
camps.notes: Monday to Friday 8 am to 3 pm, closed Friday July 3. REC-LOT at Brookdale School (turning 4 by October 1, 2026, and entering kindergarten); REC-PARK at Laning School (entering grades 1 and 2); Elementary Zone at F.N. Brown School, 125 Grove Avenue (grades 3 and 4); Junior Adventure and Summer Adventure at H.B.W. Middle School, 600 Bloomfield Avenue (grades 5 to 8). Families send a nut free lunch and snack. Optional trips and walks to the Verona Community Pool cost extra for older groups. Registration opened March 30 on CommunityPass. The page does not say whether non-residents may enroll.

camps.name: Visual Arts Center of New Jersey Summer Art Camp for Kids
camps.operator_name: Visual Arts Center of New Jersey
camps.description_short: Weekly art camp for ages 5 to 9 at the Visual Arts Center in downtown Summit, 10 to 3 on weekdays. Small age groups make 2D and 3D projects around a weekly theme, such as comics and cartoons, animals or art from around the world, in paint, clay, pastel and mixed media.
camps.notes: 2026 non-member tuition $530 a week ($515 early bird before February 17); members at the Dual/Family level and up paid $520 ($505 early). The four day week of June 29 was $435 ($425 members). Extended care from 8 AM and until 5:30 PM: $30 a day, $115 a week for one end, $190 a week for both. Lunch and snack come from home. The center also runs separate Tween (10 to 12) and Teen (13 and up) art camps and a Saturday camp. Availability shown is as of the page check; most 2026 weeks were waitlist only.

camps.name: Wayne Rec Summer Camp
camps.description_short: Eight week township day camp at the Wayne Community Center for grades K to 6, with daily swimming in the indoor pool, outdoor games and sports, themed weeks and optional weekly field trips.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Daily swimming in the Community Center's indoor pool.
camps.notes: Weekly rate $250; Community Center standard and premium members pay $220. Camp 9 am to 4:30 pm. Before care 7:30 to 9 am and after care 4:30 to 6 pm, $50 each per week. Week 1 runs four days (no camp July 3) and the page gives no separate price for it. Field trips cost $30 to $80 each. Families pack lunch; a paid lunch option is offered. Register online or at the Community Center.

camps.name: Wayne Summer Day Camp
camps.operator_name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Northwest New Jersey
camps.description_short: Full day Boys & Girls Club camp at the air conditioned 36,000 square foot Wayne clubhouse for children entering kindergarten through grade 8, 7:15 AM to 6:30 PM. Kids play in two gyms, use the tech lab and game room, swim off site, and go on field trips that are included in tuition.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Refunds until April 1, less a 5% processing fee. After that, refunds only if the spot can be filled, or in a family hardship.
camps.notes: Eight weeks, June 29 to August 21, plus Vacation Club days August 24 to 26. Included trips: Monster Mini Golf and T-Bowl Bowling for all, Turtle Back Zoo, SkyZone and Frog Falls for K to 5, Ice Vault, Tomahawk Lake and Mountain Creek for grades 6 to 8. Optional trips and science and cooking classes cost extra. The page's 2026 price table didn't come through as text, so no price is recorded. Subsidy families contact the directors to register. The same club runs a separate Wayne Early Education Summer Camp.
